gauge_reading: The 12-fold ambiguity canonically projects 3-to-1 onto the four points of the base W33 line. Choosing a distinguished point reduces the ambiguity to one triple; the bare geometry does not distinguish a point.
theorem: The twelve local affine completions are not featureless: their disjointness graph is four disjoint triangles, and those four 3-packets are uniquely equivariantly indexed by the four points on the underlying W33 line.
